mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above its 12-month moving average signals a strengthening consumer demand environment, which historically correlates with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 growth above its moving average fails to predict positive 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals weakening manufacturing output, which historically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines fail to predict negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above its 12-month moving average signals a tightening monetary cycle, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS increases fail to predict negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above its 12-month moving average signals labor market weakness, which historically correlates with negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If UNRATE increases fail to predict negative 20-day forward returns in more than 60% of cases, or if the Rank IC falls below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
